notes: Filter: USGSPCode 00618 (Nitrate, dissolved, mg/L as N), ActivityType Sample-Routine, media subdivision Groundwater (excludes leachate, soil moisture, elutriation, QC replicates). Non-detects (Not Detected, no value) use the reporting limit as upper bound, 0 as lower bound; medians substitute the limit. Last result = latest date/time; 30 well-period groups had same-day multiple results (tie order arbitrary). Pooled medians fall (1.99 to 1.60) but the cohort changes are split 84 down / 101 up, with median paired change ~+0.01 mg/L; cohort medians (2.18 to 1.86) differ by a small amount without a consistent direction. Pooled drop mostly reflects different wells in each period (300 early-only, 358 late-only). Single last-sample comparisons ignore seasonality and sampling-depth/method changes.
